subject: Eval assets exchange & MAP — Converso pilot
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@veridian.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evaluation assets for Converso pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Converso's team is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. To move from POC -> pilot quickly we want to exchange a small set of evaluation assets so our ML team can run a fidelity pass and compare outputs.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a short prompt pack (examples + guardrail prompts), a 20k-sentence probe dataset (anonymized), and the acceptance testcases you mentioned? In return, Veridian will provide a 2000-example labeled probe set and the acceptance criteria our product team will use.

Key constraints we need on your side:
- Ephemeral access (no copies retained longer than 60 days)
- No reuse for training outside the pilot
- Audit logs for inference requests (token-level not required, but request/response hashes)
- Can we lock the dataset behind an ephemeral sandbox and a scoped API key?

We should set a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: asset handoff, staging, acceptance window, and close timeline. Would appreciate a sample MAP / timeline from Redwood and a short list of usage constraints you require.

We're targeting pilot signoff by end of September if possible.

Thanks — copying Elena (Prod lead) for follow-up on acceptance tests.

Best,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Integrations, Veridian AI
[Attachment: veridian-mpa-template.docx (32 KB, DOCX)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@veridian.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation assets for Converso pilot

Hi Sanjay — great to hear the team is ready to move.

We can do the exchange under a short MAP and scoped access controls. Summary proposal below; I attached a one-page MAP draft and a tiny promptpack sample for your engineers to sanity-check.

Proposed MAP & timeline (high level)
- Day 0 (Sept 13): Signed mutual NDA & MAP signoff (DocuSign link when you confirm).
- Day 2 (Sept 15): Redwood pushes promptpack-sample.zip + acceptance-tests.csv into ephemeral sandbox.
- Day 5 (Sept 18): Veridian uploads labeled probe set and testcases to the same sandbox.
- Day 7–21 (Sept 20–Oct 4): Acceptance window (two weeks). Both sides run acceptance checks and exchange failure cases.
- Day 22 (Oct 5): Close decision & either extend pilot or initiate contract talks.

Usage constraints (Redwood requirements)
- Retention: Redwood will keep copies only for up to 90 days post-handoff, then purge (we can shorten to 60 if your compliance requires it; let us know).
- No training: Neither party may use exchanged datasets to train models for commercial release without explicit written permission.
- Access: Assets live in an ephemeral bucket tied to a scoped API key and IP allow-list. Keys can be rotated and revoked.
- Audit: We will provide request-level logs (timestamp, request id, model variant, response hash) for the acceptance period.

Technical & ops points
- Sandbox: Marissa will provision an ephemeral sandbox with restricted egress and a single-scoped API key; includes S3-stub storage and VPC egress rules.
- Security review: Karthik to validate that the environment meets Veridian's security checklist and confirm retention/purge automation.

Attachments included: map-draft.pdf (one-page MAP), promptpack-sample.zip (small sample prompts), acceptance-tests.csv (example acceptance testcases).

If this looks good I can send a DocuSign with the MAP + standard Confidentiality addendum. Proposed DocuSign + asset push on Sept 13.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: map-draft.pdf (9 KB, PDF)]
[Attachment: promptpack-sample.zip (60 KB, ZIP)]
[Attachment: acceptance-tests.csv (4 KB, CSV)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Converso pilot — sandbox & compliance checklist

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sanjay's ask and the MAP sketch I sent. Quick ops checklist before I send DocuSign: 

Marissa: can you confirm the sandbox template below is available on Sept 15 and call out the retention/purge job?
- Ephemeral bucket with TTL policy (90/60 day option)
- Scoped API key with read-only object access and inference-only token
- Simple metrics endpoint + request id correlation logs

Karthik: please review the usage constraint wording — Sanjay asked specifically for 60-day retention and non-training clause. Also need to confirm log retention window (we usually keep logs 180 days but can generate an export for them during acceptance).

Also note: we need an acceptance-tests ingestion endpoint (SFTP or signed URL) and a small script from ours that runs their acceptance-tests.csv. Marissa, can you include a runbook (upload -> trigger ingestion -> test-run -> report export)?

If you both sign off I will send the DocuSign to Sanjay + Elena and schedule the push.

Hannah

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@veridian.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena@veridian.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T08:45:00-07:00

Sanjay

Perfect — thanks Sanjay. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- DocuSign: I will send the MAP + Redwood confidentiality addendum with a 60-day retention option (we'll default to 90 but accept 60 per your request). Expect link in ~30m.
- Asset push: Marissa will push promptpack-sample.zip + acceptance-tests.csv to the ephemeral sandbox on Sept 15 immediately after countersignature. If your team needs the files earlier for internal review we can SFTP them under an encrypted channel.
- Security: Karthik will confirm the purge automation and provide the audit-log export template.
- Acceptance: two-week window (Sept 20–Oct 4) with a joint review call on Oct 5 to go over failure cases and next steps.

Action items:
- Hannah: send DocuSign (MAP + addendum) — in progress
- Marissa: prepare sandbox template, runbook, and push on asset handoff
- Karthik: security signoff and log export template
- Sanjay / Elena: countersign NDA & MAP, upload labeled probe set by Sept 18

Looking forward to getting this moving.

Thanks,
Hannah
